text: 🎬 RJ Mitte, Flynn on 'Breaking Bad', has died at 34 His reps confirmed the death of RJ Mitte , who played Walter White Jr. across 56 episodes of 'Breaking Bad'. TMZ reports that a county official in Texas confirmed it, and the investigation is ongoing. If you or someone you know is struggling, call or text 988. Mitte has cerebral palsy, and he played Flynn without hiding it. That gave a disabled actor a lasting place on one of TV's great dramas. He also worked as an ambassador for United Cerebral Palsy and Shriners Children's. Flynn was the family's moral compass, and the show needed him to be that. ✈️ Add to watchlist

🍿 Hexed: Disney bets a teen witch and a grumpy cat can carry an original 📆 Release: November 25, 2026 🎭 Genre: #Animation · #Fantasy · #Comedy ✈️ Add to watchlist Disney's new original follows Billie, a teenager who finds out she's a witch, voiced by Hailee Steinfeld . Walton Goggins voices a three-eyed cat with a bad attitude. The "ordinary girl turns out to be magical" premise is as old as the broom. The cat is the only thing here with a pulse of its own, and Goggins' dry menace is the right fuel for it. Original Disney animation needs exactly that kind of oddball energy to stand apart from the sequels.

🍿 Blade Runner 2099 hands the world to the replicants 📆 Release: November 25, 2026 🎭 Genre: #SciFi · #Drama ✈️ Add to watchlist The new trailer shows a world where replicants have won and are now stuck with the same questions about identity and mortality. Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer lead eight episodes on Prime Video, set 50 years after 2049. Flipping the power balance is the smart move. 'Blade Runner' always asked what makes a person, and a society run by the made rather than the makers gives that question room a two-hour film never had. You don't need to have seen 'Blade Runner' to follow it, but the rain-soaked melancholy only lands if the show earns it and doesn't just borrow the neon.
